subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should the full native macOS chat enable assistant reasoning and tool traces by default for existing users, or preserve the previous hidden behavior until users opt in?
rationale: This is an upgrade-visible persisted default that can expose substantially more internal agent activity; tests cannot determine the intended product and privacy posture.

options.title: Keep Traces Opt-In
options.body: Default the new preference to off while retaining the toolbar toggle for users who want web-style trace visibility.

options.title: Enable Traces by Default
options.body: Keep the proposed default-on behavior and explicitly accept the upgrade change with native proof and user-facing documentation.

recommendation.title: Keep Traces Opt-In
recommendation.body: Default the new preference to off while retaining the toolbar toggle for users who want web-style trace visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recorded owner for native Apple chat and realtime voice product behavior.
